thermo_fisher_vitrobot_mark_iv_standard.n: Vitrobot Mark IV standard system (climate chamber, blotting device, LN2/ethane coolant container)

thermo_scientific_cryomed_tscm48xv_stand.n: CryoMed TSCM48XV 48 L, 220-230 V, no thermal printer, with vial/straw racks

thermo_scientific_tsx60086la_standard.n: TSX60086LA, 100/230 V, standard (no CO2/LN2 backup fitted)

theva_tapestar_xl_hf.n: TAPESTAR XL-HF (0-1000 mT field), standard tape drive

theva_tapestar_xl_standard.n: TAPESTAR XL (0-120 mT field), standard tape drive

tinius_olsen_environmental_chamber_m150_.n: Environmental chamber -150 to 600 C with self-pressurising LN2 Dewar

tristan_g377_ngd1030.n: Tristan G377 with HTM-8 magnetometers and standard 7 L NGD-1030 LN2 dewar

zwickroell_robotest_i_metals_standard.n: roboTest I (Impact) for metals, standard 10-specimen tempering unit, -180 to +300 C

quantum_fibre_pigtailed_photon_source.rationale: The pigtailed source was operated at the 2.4 K base temperature of the cryocooler.
The purpose of the procedure is operation in compact closed-cycle cryocoolers without liquid cryogens.
Excitation and collection run through a single-mode fibre feedthrough to the pigtailed device.
quantum_fibre_pigtailed_photon_source.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

quantum_fibre_pigtailed_photon_source.rationale: The micropillar is electrically contacted and reverse-biased to stabilise the charge state and Stark-tune the emission by more than 150 pm.
quantum_fibre_pigtailed_photon_source.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

quantum_heralded_qubit_amplifier.rationale: The MoSi SNSPDs reach 70 % efficiency when held below 2.5 K.
Each detector is self-aligned to a single-mode optical fibre, so fibre optical access to the cold stage is required.
quantum_heralded_qubit_amplifier.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

quantum_heralded_qubit_amplifier.rationale: At least the two Bell-state-measurement detectors (D2 and D3) need their own RF readout lines; the heralding/output detector adds more.
quantum_heralded_qubit_amplifier.description: Number of coaxial / RF lines to the sample

quantum_heralded_qubit_amplifier.rationale: The nanowires are current-biased and read out electrically.
quantum_heralded_qubit_amplifier.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

quantum_heralded_qubit_amplifier.rationale: Optional: the detectors were designed for a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler; a bath cryostat below 2.5 K would also work.

quantum_spin_qubit_wafer_cryoprobing.rationale: Single-electron operation and validation of the superconducting process rely on the 1.6 K base temperature of the cryo-prober.
Whole 300 mm wafers are loaded and cooled.
Device pads must be electrically contacted by probe pins at temperature.
quantum_spin_qubit_wafer_cryoprobing.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

sci_thin_crystal_dilatometry.rationale: alpha(T) of the AgCrS2 crystal was determined over 2-50 K.
Thermal expansion was compared at zero field and 9 T.
sci_thin_crystal_dilatometry.description: Maximum documented magnetic field at the sample

sci_thin_crystal_dilatometry.rationale: The length change is read as a capacitance, so electrical leads to the dilatometer cell on the sample stage are required.
sci_thin_crystal_dilatometry.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

sci_graphene_yig_quantum_hall.rationale: Data were taken at 2.7 K and at 9 K.
The quantum Hall CAF-to-F transition is driven with fields up to 12 T.
sci_graphene_yig_quantum_hall.description: Maximum documented magnetic field at the sample

sci_graphene_yig_quantum_hall.rationale: Four-terminal and nonlocal resistance require wired contacts to the device.
sci_graphene_yig_quantum_hall.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

sci_graphene_yig_quantum_hall.rationale: Optional: the Hall bar has at least ten numbered contacts (plus a top gate).
sci_graphene_yig_quantum_hall.description: Number of DC wiring lines to the sample

sci_arpes_gold_fermi_edge.rationale: The gold Fermi-edge resolution test was performed at 7 K, the manipulator's lowest temperature.
Photoelectron spectroscopy is done under UHV to avoid surface contamination and electron scattering.
The analysis chamber is kept below 1E-10 mbar.
Synchrotron or VUV-laser photons must reach the cold sample and photoelectrons must reach the analyzer.
sci_arpes_gold_fermi_edge.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

sci_arpes_gold_fermi_edge.rationale: Optional: mu-metal shielding against the geomagnetic field protects low-energy photoelectron trajectories.
sci_arpes_gold_fermi_edge.description: Magnetic shielding of the sample space installed

sci_arpes_gold_fermi_edge.rationale: Optional: the reported quantum-material spectrum was taken at 25 K.
Optional: the reported manipulator is cooled by continuous liquid-helium flow.

astro_ge_ccd_nir_95k.rationale: Dark current and x-ray response are measured at 94.69 K.
The packaged device sits on a cold plate inside a vacuum chamber.
The chamber pressure was kept below 5e-5 torr during the measurements.
CCD clocks, biases and video output pass through the chamber to the Archon controller.
astro_ge_ccd_nir_95k.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

astro_ge_ccd_nir_95k.rationale: Optional: temperature was stable within +/-0.03 K during the dark-current measurements.
Optional: this test system cools the cold plate with liquid nitrogen.

astro_h2rg_ir_array_35k.rationale: The array is held at a constant 35 K during all cryogenic tests; the sample stage must reach and regulate at 35 K.
Optional: performance was equivalent anywhere from 35 to 39 K, so the full 35-39 K window is useful but not required.
The detector operates inside an evacuated cryostat (typical pressure ~10 microTorr).
Cryostat pressure during the tests was about 10 microTorr (1e-5 Torr); the machine must reach at least this vacuum to avoid condensation on the cold array.
The array is clocked and read out through 4 outputs via a cryogenic SIDECAR ASIC and a buffered cable to the warm MACIE card; cold-to-warm wiring feedthroughs are required.
astro_h2rg_ir_array_35k.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

astro_h2rg_ir_array_35k.rationale: Optional size gate: the array side is 2048 x 18 um = 36.864 mm, so the cold stage must clear at least that width (the packaged detector head is larger; its size is not stated).
Optional: the detector head was cooled and warmed under control at 0.5 K per minute.
Optional: the test cryostat used was a closed-cycle refrigerator system (no liquid cryogen).

astro_qubic_tes_array_320mk.rationale: The TES bath must reach ~320 mK, below the ~410 mK critical temperature, for the sensors to operate in electro-thermal feedback.
The TES focal plane is 110 mm in diameter and must fit on the sub-K stage.
TES bias and SQUID multiplexer lines run from the cold stages to the warm FPGA readout.
astro_qubic_tes_array_320mk.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

astro_qubic_tes_array_320mk.rationale: Optional: the SQUID boxes at 1 K are surrounded by a Cryophy magnetic shield; a test cryostat needs equivalent shielding for the SQUIDs.
astro_qubic_tes_array_320mk.description: Magnetic shielding of the sample space installed

astro_qubic_tes_array_320mk.rationale: Optional: dark-pixel critical temperature (~412 mK) is mapped by slowly raising the temperature through the transition, so the stage must regulate around 412 mK.
Optional: the QUBIC cryostat is pulse-tube cooled (dry); pulse-tube microphonics were the dominant excess noise.

chem_low_temperature_raman.rationale: Park et al. (2026) cooled to −140 °C, the lowest point of that paper's freezing/melting cycles; this is the paper's choice set by the phase behaviour studied, and the user confirms −140 °C as the required operating point.
Raman scattering is collected through the stage window with a microscope objective in both sources; optical access to the cold sample is intrinsic to the technique.
chem_low_temperature_raman.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

chem_low_temperature_raman.rationale: Park et al. (2026) and Pamula et al. (2025) load the sample in a 15 mm diameter quartz crucible inside the stage, so the stage must accept a 15 mm sample; this is the papers' sample format, confirmed by the user.

Pamula et al. (2025) focus through the stage with a 6.5 mm working-distance objective. The working distance that the stage window geometry requires must not exceed the objective's 6.5 mm, so a stage requiring more than 6.5 mm would be incompatible with this optical setup. Non-mandatory because a longer-WD objective could be substituted.
chem_low_temperature_raman.description: Minimum objective working distance the window geometry requires

chem_low_temperature_raman.rationale: Condensation/frost: a cold specimen or window below the frost point collects ice unless the sample space is evacuated or purged with dry gas (pm_015, pm_016). Applies only when the operating temperature is at or below 0 °C.

chem_phase_transition_pom.rationale: The wax procedure scanned 203-393 K; this is the paper's range and the user should confirm it for their sample.
Observation through a polarized optical microscope needs optical access to the sample.
chem_phase_transition_pom.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

chem_phase_transition_pom.rationale: Optional: the second (PBS) procedure heated at 30 °C/min; the wax paper does not state POM ramp rates.

Condensation/frost: a cold specimen or window below the frost point collects ice unless the sample space is evacuated or purged with dry gas (pm_015, pm_016). Applies only when the operating temperature is at or below 0 °C.

chem_temperature_dependent_photoluminesc.rationale: Swidinsky et al. (2024) recorded spectra from 300 K down to 4 K (±0.1 K); the 4 K base is that paper's choice (Shyam et al. 2026 stop at 20 K). User confirms 4–300 K as the required range.
Excitation and emission pass through cryostat windows (borosilicate in Swidinsky et al.; quartz in Shyam et al.); optical access is intrinsic to photoluminescence in a cryostat.
chem_temperature_dependent_photoluminesc.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

chem_temperature_dependent_photoluminesc.rationale: Swidinsky et al. (2024) used 25 × 25 × 2 mm fused silica substrates mounted on the coldfinger; the cryostat must accept a 25 mm wide sample. Sample size is this paper's choice, confirmed by the user.
Swidinsky et al. (2024) used 25 × 25 × 2 mm fused silica substrates; the cryostat must accept a 25 mm long sample. This paper's choice, confirmed by the user.
Both papers evacuate the sample space before cooling (Swidinsky et al. below 1e-6 mbar; Shyam et al. 1e-5 mbar); an evacuable sample space is required.
Swidinsky et al. (2024) held the sample below 1e-6 mbar (100 uPa). Non-mandatory: Shyam et al. (2026) worked at 1e-5 mbar, so the exact vacuum level is a per-paper choice.

phys_niobium_rrr.rationale: RRR uses resistivity at 300 K and at 10 K in the same fixture.
Four-point probe leads and thermometer wiring must reach the samples.
phys_niobium_rrr.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

phys_niobium_rrr.rationale: Fermilab samples are ~75 mm long strips (~2x2 mm2).
The series-connected samples are driven with 100 mA.
phys_niobium_rrr.description: Maximum excitation current of the installed electrical module

phys_niobium_rrr.rationale: Both reported systems cool the samples with liquid helium.

expa_teo2_bolometer.rationale: The source reports approximately 10 mK operating temperature; this is a nominal point.
Absorbers, thermistors and low-noise thermal readout are indispensable.
expa_teo2_bolometer.description: Documented installed function: teo2 bolometer calorimetry

phys_lar_sipm_ln2_qualification.rationale: DCR and noise specifications are verified at 77 K.
Sensors are immersed (dived) in liquid nitrogen.
Bias and signal leads (triaxial cables to the SMU, cryogenic amplifier) must reach the sensor.
phys_lar_sipm_ln2_qualification.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

phys_lar_sipm_ln2_qualification.rationale: A 6x6 mm2 sensor has a circumscribed diameter of 8.5 mm.

expc_energy_tensile_20k.rationale: Select the documented20 K mechanical test condition relevant to liquid-hydrogen service. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Cryogenic grips, a mechanical load path and force/strain measurement are essential. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
expc_energy_tensile_20k.description: Installed cryogenic specimen grips, mechanical load frame and tensile measurement apparatus

energy_rebco_ic_axial_strain_77k.rationale: All Ic-strain measurements were made at 77 K.
Ic is measured by four-point transport, requiring current and voltage-tap wiring to the sample.
energy_rebco_ic_axial_strain_77k.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

energy_rebco_ic_axial_strain_77k.rationale: Optional: the tape is soldered over a 45 mm length of the U-spring.

expc_energy_insulation_boiloff.rationale: Replicate NASA's standard cold boundary. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Independently control the warm boundary; a cold cryostat alone is insufficient. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
expc_energy_insulation_boiloff.description: Controlled warm-side boundary temperature of a guarded insulation calorimeter

expc_energy_insulation_boiloff.rationale: The calorimetric boiloff measurement train is essential, rather than temperature capability alone. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
expc_energy_insulation_boiloff.description: Installed steady-state liquid-cryogen boiloff calorimetry measurement apparatus

aero_mars_prt_thermal_cycling.rationale: Protoflight/qualification cycles -135 C to 70 C (138.15 K to 343.15 K).
Planetary-protection cycle to +125 C (398.15 K) for two hours.
Optional: PRT resistances are monitored to detect bond failures.
aero_mars_prt_thermal_cycling.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

aero_ecss_equipment_tvac.rationale: Clause 5.5.4.2a: equipment operating in space vacuum must be tested in thermal vacuum.
Functional tests at hot and cold operating temperatures require powered, instrumented equipment inside the chamber.
aero_ecss_equipment_tvac.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

aero_ecss_equipment_tvac.rationale: Optional: functional tests start only after a dwell of at least 2 h, so the facility must hold a plateau for at least 2 h.

aero_gevs_unit_tvac.rationale: Thermal-vacuum cycling requires an evacuated chamber.
Section 2.6.3.2.4: chamber pressure less than 1.33e-3 Pa (1e-5 torr).
Items electrically operational during pressure transitions undergo an electrical discharge check; the unit is powered and tested through feedthroughs.
aero_gevs_unit_tvac.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

aero_gevs_unit_tvac.rationale: Optional: Table 2.6-1 suggests transitions up to 1.0 C/min; a facility able to ramp at 1 C/min keeps the test schedule.
Optional: unit hot and cold operational plateaus last at least 4 h.

env_specimen_bank_ln2_vapour_archive.rationale: Sub-specimens are stored below -150 C (123.15 K).
The archive keeps specimens in the vapour above liquid nitrogen.
Each archived sub-specimen portion is about 10 g.

env_fresh_inp_plate_freezing.rationale: Each run sweeps the sample from 0 C to -35 C (273.15-238.15 K).
The calibration and spectra apply to a 1 C/min ramp.
env_fresh_inp_plate_freezing.description: Documented controlled cooling-rate magnitudes; do not substitute heating rates.

env_fresh_inp_plate_freezing.rationale: Freezing events are detected optically with a camera viewing the wells.
env_fresh_inp_plate_freezing.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

expansion_b_env_soil_cryogenic_preparati.rationale: Actual comminution with cryogenic cooling is essential.
expansion_b_env_soil_cryogenic_preparati.description: Mechanical sample comminution with documented cryogenic cooling.

expansion_b_env_soil_cryogenic_preparati.rationale: Select the manufacturer's nominal LN2-cooled CryoMill procedure; a warm mixer mill does not establish this operating condition.

nuc_cryo_ion_irradiation_tgs.rationale: Irradiation and in situ TGS at 30 K.
Laser TGS beams must reach the sample with the ion beam.
nuc_cryo_ion_irradiation_tgs.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

nuc_cryo_ion_irradiation_tgs.rationale: 13 x 15 mm footprint, circumscribed diameter 19.85 mm rounded up to 20 mm.

nuc_ipi_d2_pellet_high_speed.rationale: Pellet ice must be lowered to ~7 K and kept stable.
Upgraded cooler (1.5 W at 4.2 K) chosen to improve ice quality.

expa_cicc_critical_current.rationale: SULTAN's documented lower operating point is 4.5 K.
The selected boundary test requests the documented 10.8 T field.
expa_cicc_critical_current.description: Maximum documented magnetic field at the sample

expa_cicc_critical_current.rationale: A conductor transformer/current circuit and voltage-tap measurement are required.
expa_cicc_critical_current.description: Documented installed function: high current conductor test

photon_fibre_pigtailed_qd_source.rationale: The pigtailed source was operated at the cryocooler base temperature of 2.4 K (the 5 K free-space setup gave lower indistinguishability).
The QD charge state and emission wavelength are set by a bias voltage through electrical contacts on the chip.
photon_fibre_pigtailed_qd_source.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

photon_fibre_pigtailed_qd_source.rationale: Optional: the deployable source runs in a closed-cycle G-M cryocooler without liquid cryogens.

photon_mosi_heralded_qubit_amplifier.rationale: The MoSi SNSPDs reach their 70% efficiency only at T < 2.5 K, so the detector stage must reach 2.5 K or below.
Each of the four nanowire detectors (D1-D4) must be current-biased and read out electrically to record the 3- and 4-fold heralding coincidences.
photon_mosi_heralded_qubit_amplifier.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

photon_mosi_heralded_qubit_amplifier.rationale: Optional: the detectors were designed for and operated in a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler (no liquid-helium bath).

photon_er_linbo3_afc_memory.rationale: Long-lived Zeeman population storage requires spin-polarised Er ions at about 0.7 K.
All AFCs were prepared under a 3 kG (300 mT) field along the crystal c-axis.
photon_er_linbo3_afc_memory.description: Maximum documented magnetic field at the sample

photon_er_linbo3_afc_memory.rationale: Optional: the setup exposed the waveguide to fields up to 5 kG (500 mT).
photon_er_linbo3_afc_memory.description: Maximum documented magnetic field at the sample

mat_cryo_tem_cdw_nanoflakes.rationale: The smallest flakes only order (or are shown not to order) at the 20 K base temperature of the liquid-helium holder.
Warming must pass through the bulk CDW transition (210-230 K) to locate each flake's melting temperature.
Optional: the 20 K base was reached with continuous liquid-helium flow.

mat_monolayer_wse2_lowtemp_photoluminesc.rationale: The five-peak spectrum and defect lifetimes are taken at a 4 K sample temperature.
Optional: the temperature-dependent TRPL series spans 4-120 K (above 77 K the authors also used an LN2-cooled stage).
The laser must reach the flake and the PL must be collected optically.
mat_monolayer_wse2_lowtemp_photoluminesc.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

mat_monolayer_wse2_lowtemp_photoluminesc.rationale: Optional: high-NA (0.82) collection partially captures dark-exciton emission.
mat_monolayer_wse2_lowtemp_photoluminesc.description: Documented numerical aperture of the optical access

mat_lowtemp_xrd_phase_transitions_ttk600.rationale: The phase sequence is recorded from 135 C (408.15 K) down to -190 C (83.15 K).
-190 C is reached only with the sample space evacuated; with gas atmospheres the LN2-cooled stage stops at -150 C.
Optional: the documented low-temperature vacuum condition is 1e-2 mbar.
Optional: the chamber reached -190 C with liquid-nitrogen cooling; another cooling method reaching 83 K would also do.

mfg_waste_tyre_ln2_impact_crumbing.rationale: The tyre is cooled by complete immersion in a liquid-nitrogen bath.
The rubber must be taken below its glass-transition temperature (215 K) so it shatters instead of deforming; the cooling medium must reach below 215 K.
The whole tyre goes into the vessel; its 13 inch landing (rim) diameter is a lower bound on the clear diameter needed (the outer diameter, with the 75% x 185 mm sidewall on each side, is larger).
Optional: the immersion lasted up to 300 s depending on tyre mass and wall thickness.
mfg_waste_tyre_ln2_impact_crumbing.description: Maximum documented hold duration for the specified thermal process.

mfg_lng_austenitic_weld_charpy_minus196c.rationale: The qualification test temperature for LNG weldments is -196 C; specimens must be conditioned at -196 C (77.15 K).
Optional: the full toughness-versus-temperature curves were measured at +20, -120 and -196 C.

expansion_b_manufacturing_sbr_rubber_dsc.rationale: The experiment needs differential heat-flow sensing against a reference.
expansion_b_manufacturing_sbr_rubber_dsc.description: Differential scanning calorimetry with a heat-flow sensor and reference is available.

expansion_b_manufacturing_sbr_rubber_dsc.rationale: Replicate the reported -100 to220 C heating window.
Dynamic nitrogen atmosphere is part of the reported measurement; do not assume it is installed on every calorimeter.
expansion_b_manufacturing_sbr_rubber_dsc.description: Dynamic nitrogen purge of the calorimeter is documented.

semi_aecq100_grade0_tc_ptc.rationale: Grade 0 TC (test A4) cold extreme is -55 C = 218.15 K.
Grade 0 TC hot extreme is +150 C = 423.15 K.
Grade 0 PTC (test A5, JESD22-A105) cycles the ambient from -40 C (233.15 K) to +150 C (423.15 K).
Power temperature cycling runs the parts powered during the cycling (thermal shut-down must not occur), so bias wiring into the chamber is needed.
semi_aecq100_grade0_tc_ptc.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

semi_mil883_tc_condition_c.rationale: Condition C cold step is -65 C (+0/-10), so the working zone must reach -65 C = 208.15 K or colder (third column of the cold row; columns are conditions A-F).
Condition C hot step is +150 C (+15/-0), so the chamber must reach +150 C = 423.15 K or hotter (third column of the hot row).

semi_finfet_5nm_cryo_probe.rationale: Transistors were measured over the whole span from 300 K down to 10 K (10 K was the lowest stable temperature with probes landed).
The probed die sits in the evacuated sample space of the probe station.
Each transistor terminal (gate, source, drain, bulk) is contacted by its own probe, so four probe arms are needed.
The DUT is biased and measured by the B1500A through the probes.
semi_finfet_5nm_cryo_probe.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

semi_finfet_5nm_cryo_probe.rationale: Optional: the source used a two-stage closed-cycle refrigerator rather than a liquid cryogen.

metro_argon_triple_point_sprt.rationale: The calibration point is the argon triple point, 83.8058 K.
The argon has to be frozen, so the apparatus must cool below the triple point.
The Isotech procedure freezes the cell with LN2. NIST also has a closed-cycle apparatus, so LN2 is not mandatory.

metro_icvgt_3k_to_neon.rationale: The gas thermometer defines the scale from 3 K to 24.5561 K.
The bulb has to reach 3 K.

metro_helium_vapour_pressure_scale.rationale: The scale covers 0.65 K to 5.0 K.
The bulbs are suspended inside a vacuum jacket.
The reference systems use a liquid 4He bath; cryocoolers are an alternative.

auto_iec62660_low_temp_capacity.rationale: Low-temperature capacity option at -20 C (253.15 K).
Reference capacity at the standard condition 23 C (296.15 K).
Discharge capacity is measured electrically, so the cell must be connected to the cycler inside the chamber.
auto_iec62660_low_temp_capacity.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

auto_iec62660_low_temp_capacity.rationale: Optional: the standard condition tolerance is +/-2 C, so the chamber should hold the set point within 2 K.

auto_iso16750_constant_temperature.rationale: Low-temperature storage is performed at -40 C (233.15 K) for 24 h.
High-temperature storage is performed at 85 C (358.15 K) for 48 h.
The low-temperature operation test runs the DUT electrically (operating mode 3.3/4.3) at Tmin for 24 h, so supply and signal wiring to the DUT inside the chamber is required.
auto_iso16750_constant_temperature.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

auto_iso16750_temperature_cycling.rationale: Code C sets Tmin = -40 C (233.15 K) and Tmax = 65 C (338.15 K); the chamber must cover both dwell temperatures.
The DUT is electrically operated and functionally tested at the end of the Tmin and Tmax dwells, so it must be wired through the chamber.
auto_iso16750_temperature_cycling.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

bio_bacterial_glycerol_stock_minus80.rationale: The stock is stored at -80 °C (193.15 K) for years.
Optional handling: keep the vial on dry ice while streaking so it does not thaw.

bio_freeze_substitution_afs2.rationale: The programme spans -90 °C (183.15 K) to 20 °C (293.15 K).
Independent protocol: chamber pre-cooled to -90 °C before samples enter the freeze-substitution medium.
The 6 mm middle plate / sapphire disk is released into acetone pre-cooled in the AFS chamber.
The fastest programmed warming step is 10 °C/h (166.67 mK/min, rounded up to 167); the unit must ramp at least this fast under control.
Frozen specimens and the osmium/glutaraldehyde fixative tubes are kept and transferred under liquid nitrogen.

bio_mx_cryocrystallography_100k.rationale: Diffraction data are collected with the crystal at 100 K.
The crystal must be held below the lower bound of the water glass-transition range (about 136 K).
Crystals are flash-cooled in liquid nitrogen before data collection.

def_mil810_502_cold_operation_c2.rationale: The chamber air must be held at the C2 low extreme of -46 C (227.15 K) for the operating soak.
The machine's lowest temperature must be -46 C (227.15 K) or colder; lets machines documented by a base temperature decide.
The low temperature is held for at least two hours after the test item stabilizes (plus the stabilization time).
The item is checked out operating inside the chamber; mains- or bench-powered items need a cable port, battery items do not, so this is optional.
def_mil810_502_cold_operation_c2.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

def_mil810_502_munitions_storage_c3.rationale: The item is stored at the C3 storage/transit temperature of -51 C (222.15 K).
The machine's lowest temperature must be -51 C (222.15 K) or colder.
Explosives/munitions need at least 72 h at -51 C after stabilization, so the chamber must run unattended that long; continuous-run capability is rarely documented, so not mandatory.

def_hot_mwir_idca_120k.rationale: The HOT barrier FPA operates at approximately 120 K.
The FPA is housed in a vacuum dewar.
Infrared photons must reach the FPA through the cold shield and cold filter.
def_hot_mwir_idca_120k.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

def_hot_mwir_idca_120k.rationale: ROIC signals leave the dewar through hermetic electrical feedthroughs.
def_hot_mwir_idca_120k.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

def_hot_mwir_idca_120k.rationale: Cooling is by a mechanical cryocooler integrated with the dewar; no liquid cryogen in the field.

med_ffp_contact_shock_freezing.rationale: Plasma must be brought to a core temperature of -30 C or below, so the freezer must reach -30 C or colder.
Regulatory minimum for FFP: frozen at -18 C or colder.
Operating point used for storage in the study: -40 C deep freezer (any -18 C or colder store meets the AABB rule).
The contact shock freezer used operates at -50 C, which achieved the -30 C core in 40 min.

med_glycerolized_rbc_frozen_storage.rationale: The approved high-glycerol method stores the units at -80 C.
Regulatory limit: frozen RBCs are frozen and kept at -65 C or colder.
Machines documenting only a base temperature must reach -80 C.

med_cord_blood_unit_ln2_banking.rationale: Units are stored immersed in the liquid phase of liquid nitrogen at -196 C.
Liquid-phase storage requires a vessel that holds liquid nitrogen.
Physical basis: below the ~-130 C glass transition of water biological activity stops; informative lower bound for any acceptable store.

geo_sea_ice_column_contaminant_uptake.rationale: The circulating cryothermostat must hold the cooling element at -5.1 C (268.05 K).

geo_seawater_nutrient_frozen_storage.rationale: The storage space must reach -20 C (253.15 K) or colder.
Lowest achievable storage temperature must be -20 C or colder.

geo_noble_gas_he_ne_cryotrap.rationale: The cold trap must hold 14 K for Ne adsorption and then be heated to 100 K to release Ne, so the trap temperature must span 14-100 K.
Quantitative Ne adsorption needs the trap at 14 K or colder.
The trap temperature is computer-set and must stay within 0.1 K during Ne adsorption.
The cold trap sits in the all-metal ultrahigh-vacuum extraction and purification line.
The extraction line is pumped to about 1e-7 mbar before the sample is opened (approximate figure, so optional).
Water vapour and condensable gases are frozen onto an all-metal trap and a zeolite trap cooled by liquid nitrogen (separate traps on the same line).

food_tuna_ultralow_frozen_storage.rationale: Colour stability (no metMb increase) needs storage at -45 °C (228.15 K) or colder; either a documented range reaching that low or a documented lowest temperature settles it.
Storage warmer than -40 °C (233.15 K) increased metMb in low-pH meat; optional because the -45 °C requirement already covers it.

food_blueberry_ln2_quick_freezing.rationale: The best-performing treatment, LN-120 °C, needs the freezing space at -120 °C (153.15 K).
Freezing is done by direct immersion in liquid nitrogen.
Tg' (-52.55 °C = 220.6 K) is the freezing end point, so the machine must reach below it.
Reproducing the full comparison needs set points from -120 °C to -80 °C (153.15-193.15 K); optional beyond the -120 °C operating point.
The fruit is immersed directly in liquid nitrogen; supporting flag only.
food_blueberry_ln2_quick_freezing.description: Direct liquid-nitrogen immersion of the documented sample carrier.

food_bull_semen_ln2_vapour_box_freezing.rationale: Freezing happens in the vapour 4.5 cm above a liquid-nitrogen pool and the straws are then plunged into the liquid nitrogen, so the container must hold liquid nitrogen.
The frozen straws end up immersed in liquid nitrogen, whose temperature the livestock-embryo protocol states as -196 °C (77.15 K); the storage space must reach it.
The straws are plunged directly into liquid nitrogen after vapour freezing; supporting flag only.
food_bull_semen_ln2_vapour_box_freezing.description: Direct liquid-nitrogen immersion of the documented sample carrier.
